answer:
**Best estimate:** **3,300,000 units** of **HARBOE** in **CSD / carbonated soft drinks** sold through **Danish retail** in **2026-01**.

**Estimated range:** **2,500,000–4,800,000 units**  
**Confidence:** **Low-to-moderate, ~35%** — there is no public monthly brand/unit sales data, so this is triangulated from market size, Harboe’s published share/penetration indicators, seasonality, and likely pack mix.

**How I estimated it:**

- Denmark’s soft-drinks market was about **966 million liters in 2025**, and DTU notes that retail/off-trade represented **86% of total soft-drinks sales** and **80% of soda/CSD sales**. ([food.dtu.dk](https://www.food.dtu.dk/-/media/institutter/foedevareinstituttet/publikationer/pub-2025/markeds-og-vareundersoegelse-af-energidrikke-i-danmark-final-report.pdf))  
- Harboe reported a **soft-drinks value share of 8.1%** in Danish grocery/hard discount MAT week 20 2025; because Harboe is a lower-price brand, I estimate its **volume share** in CSD somewhat higher, around **12%–13%**. ([investor.harboes.com](https://investor.harboes.com/static-files/88ec4164-f72a-4d68-95b6-f85bb8680432?utm_source=openai))  
- Harboe also said **54% of Danish consumers bought a Harboe soft drink in 2025** and that its soft drinks were on shelves at **virtually all Danish retailers**, supporting a material national share rather than a niche-brand estimate. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/33c7dc53-b05d-3479-890b-eb407fb6b860/report.pdf))  
- I assume January is below an average month for CSD because Harboe says summer weather materially affects beverage demand; I used about **7.2% of annual CSD volume** for January. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/33c7dc53-b05d-3479-890b-eb407fb6b860/report.pdf))  
- Converting estimated Harboe January liters to units, I used an average of roughly **1.2–1.3 liters per retail unit**, reflecting Harboe’s heavy PET-bottle mix but allowing for smaller formats.
